'''House Arathdar''' was one of the known [[Nobility|Noble]] [[House]]s of [[Malkier]] until the nation's [[Fall of Malkier|fall]] in {{ne|955}}.

The only known member of the House was Lady [[El'Leanna Mandragoran|Leanna Arathdar]]. She became queen consort of Malkier with her marriage to [[al'Akir Mandragoran]].
